prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Eisenhof", the massive justice complex of the middle ring: a big enclosed inner courtyard surrounded by heavy dark basalt stone walls with riveted steel beams. A wide courtyard of large dark grey stone slabs fills the middle of the image from the left garden to the right gate - this is the large walkable area, wet after rain with puddles mirroring cold white floodlight and a little cyan and violet neon.
TOP CENTER-LEFT, on the upper building row: the courthouse - the most eye-catching spot: a tall dark stone facade with steel columns and a big double wooden door under a glowing pale-blue symbol of balance scales (a symbol, no letters); part of its roof is cut away so we look down into the courtroom and see rows of wooden benches and a raised judge's bench inside.
TOP RIGHT, on the upper building row: the cell block, a grim heavy wing of dark stone and steel with rows of small barred windows, a heavy reinforced steel door with a small grated visitor hatch, a red warning lamp above it.
TOP LEFT CORNER: a small lost-and-found storeroom with a narrow door and a dusty window full of piled boxes, coats and coffee cups. On the wall between courthouse and cell block: a public government terminal with a glowing cyan screen (picture only).
LEFT SIDE: the court garden - a neat raked zen gravel garden with a few round stones, a bonsai-like dwarf tree, and two raised wooden vegetable beds with cabbages, tomatoes and one enormous gleaming golden cucumber; a simple wooden park bench under a small lantern.
CENTER: a weathered bronze statue of a blindfolded justice robot holding scales on a square stone plinth.
RIGHT EDGE: the release gate - a heavy steel gate frame in the outer wall with a rotating steel turnstile, yellow-black hazard stripes on the ground, and a small glass guard booth with a desk lamp and a coffee machine right next to it.
BOTTOM LEFT: an evidence warehouse with a big corrugated roller shutter, stacked sealed crates and a forklift pallet in front.
BOTTOM CENTER: a small clinic door with a glowing green cross symbol (no letters) and a narrow waiting bench. BOTTOM CENTER-RIGHT: a court canteen with a serving hatch, a steaming coffee urn and two small standing tables in front.
BOTTOM RIGHT, near the gate: a hidden corner behind a stack of crates and an old tarp, with a crate used as a card table.
Small stuff at the edges: floodlight masts, steel bollards, a camera on a pole, rain gutters, a cleaning robot dock, cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: RIGHT edge (east) - the release gate with the turnstile, opening to a lit plaza beyond; TOP - the courthouse double door and the cell block steel door.
Time: late evening, after rain, cold white floodlights and warm yellow windows.
